title: Chapter 167 Void Palace
content:
Chapter 167 Void Palace

Feeling something strange there, Lu Daosheng stopped and looked over there.

I saw a shadow slowly emerging from there.

"Did you do this?"

The shadow asked.

There was no one else here, so the one asking was naturally Lu Daosheng.

And Lu Daosheng did not hide it, there was no need.

"It was me."

Seeing Lu Daosheng admit it, the shadow nodded.

"Then die."

Buzz——

Suddenly, a strange force came directly towards Lu Daosheng.

However, after the force came into contact with Lu Daosheng, it dissipated directly.

"Huh?"

The shadow made a slight sound of doubt, obviously feeling incredible that Lu Daosheng could take his attack safely.

"Are you not a creature from this world?"

The shadow continued to ask.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled.

Did he show that he was too good-tempered.

I saw that Lu Daosheng stretched out a hand, and suddenly, a terrifying suction force surged out.

Buzz——

"What?!"

The next moment, the shadow flew directly into Lu Daosheng's palm, like an ant.

"Heh, no wonder it's so arrogant, it's not the real body."

Lu Daosheng chuckled.

At this moment, he already knew what was going on with this shadow.

"Do you know who I am?"

The shadow in Lu Daosheng's palm was obviously angry, but he couldn't do anything to Lu Daosheng.

But even so, he wouldn't bow his head.

It's just a shadow that can control him, which is nothing.

If his real body came in person, he believed that Lu Daosheng would never be as calm and composed as he is now.

Looking at the shadow in his palm, which was still so arrogant, Lu Daosheng said calmly: "I don't care who you are, why, do you want to retaliate against me?"

Hearing this, the shadow sneered: "No matter who you are, where you are, I declare that you, including everyone related to you, will completely disappear from this world."

Arrogant.

This is what Lu Daosheng felt from the shadow.

It seems that this guy has been arrogant for a long time, otherwise he would never be like this.

And Lu Daosheng's face turned cold instantly.

What he hates most is the guy who talks big, not to mention that the other party also talks big about his family.

Boom!

As Lu Daosheng exerted force with his palm, the phantom shattered directly.

After glancing around and confirming that there was no threat, Lu Daosheng stood up and disappeared on the spot.

At the unknown border.

Yan Lingyun and his daughter were talking.

"Mom, are you going to the upper realm?"

Lu Xue asked.

Yan Lingyun wiped Lu Xue's head and smiled: "Don't worry, mom will definitely take you. Even if you don't have mom, don't you still have your dad?"

"But what about the Divine Dynasty?"

Divine Dynasty?

Yan Lingyun was slightly stunned, and a touch of relief suddenly appeared in her eyes.

"Xiaoxue, actually, I originally planned to disband the Divine Dynasty after dealing with the Soul Devouring Clan, and then go to the Immortal Realm."

"Because with my current ability, I don't have that much ability."

"But it's different now."

Hearing this, Lu Xue's eyes lit up.

"Yes, there is Dad."

There is nothing in this world that my father can't do.

And Yan Lingyun obviously agrees with this.

She founded the Divine Dynasty not only for the power of the Divine Dynasty, but also to protect the people of this world from the invasion of the Soul Devouring Clan.

Otherwise, after she achieved the supreme god, she could have ascended and left.

How could she have stepped into the unknown star field alone.

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly appeared.

"Huh? Daosheng, what's wrong?"

Seeing the anger in Lu Daosheng's eyes, Yan Lingyun suddenly said with some worry.

Lu Daosheng shook his head.

"Nothing, you guys go back first, I'll do something, I'll be back soon."

Leaving this sentence, Lu Daosheng disappeared directly on the spot.

He came quickly and left quickly.

On the spot, Lu Xue was a little dumbfounded, what happened?

"Mom, my dad left again."

Lu Xue said a little aggrieved.

Yan Lingyun shook her head helplessly, "Your dad said he had something to do, so it must be true, let's go back first."

"Okay."

Lu Xue nodded.

However, Yan Lingyun did not take Lu Xue back to the Divine Dynasty, but went to the deserted city instead.

.........

Chaos Void.

It was hazy here, and countless violent and wanton laws of the avenues were constantly intertwined.

Ordinary practitioners could not even last a second here.

And at this moment, a figure was moving quickly in it, as if entering an empty space!

[Host, I have finished the deduction for you]

[The other party is the brother-in-law of the master of the Void Palace, one of the five Order Palaces, Song Zhe]

After hearing what the system said, Lu Daosheng understood.

“No wonder.”

But Lu Daosheng will not show mercy just because the other party is from the Order Palace.

Dare to come to the lower world to cause trouble, and run into me, it can only be considered that the other party is unlucky.

Lu Daosheng looked indifferent, and then his speed suddenly accelerated a few points.

At the same time.

In a vast temple standing in the endless void.

“Ah! Damn, where did the ant come from, dare to provoke me like this!!”

“Master Song, calm down.”

A guard stood trembling beside a young man, with a little fear in his eyes.

It has been a long time since he saw this gentleman so angry.

Presumably, there must be some villain who has annoyed this gentleman.

At this time, a beautiful woman suddenly came slowly from a distance.

"Songzhe."

Hearing this familiar voice, Songzhe trembled all over.

The next moment, the anger on his face disappeared, replaced by a face full of smirk.

"Sister, why are you here?"

The beautiful woman's face was a little cold, and she snorted and said, "Don't you think I don't know what you did secretly."

Seeing that his affairs had been discovered, Songzhe laughed and said, "Sister, it's just a little thing, it doesn't have any impact."

"Besides, don't you still have my brother-in-law?"

Hearing this, the beautiful woman's face became even colder.

"You guy, if people from other halls know about it, your brother-in-law will not protect you at that time."

Hearing this, Songzhe nodded repeatedly, "Yes, yes, sister, you are right."

But Songzhe was disdainful in his heart.

He was just doing some small things in that very low-level world.

Could it be that the people there dare to go against me?

I guess they wouldn't dare to do it even if they had a hundred guts.

Seeing Songzhe like this, the beautiful woman sighed slightly.

I hate iron for not being able to make steel.

At this moment, she regretted bringing Songzhe to the Void Palace.

As one of the five major order palaces, the Void Palace naturally has a great influence in the world.

But that doesn't mean it is invincible.

There are also some frictions in the major order palaces.

Thinking of her husband's instructions, the beautiful woman said coldly: "From now on, you must not leave the Void Palace for half a step, and practice in seclusion for me."

Hearing this, Songzhe's face was a little ugly.

"Sister, why?"

However, Songyue didn't pay any attention to Songzhe anymore, and got up and left here directly.

Songzhe looked angry on the spot.

But he didn't know that his sister was protecting him.

At the same time, a figure suddenly appeared outside the Void Palace.
